wages.text: Wallace pledges to defend workers' right to unionize, protect prevailing wages under the Davis-Bacon Act, and support project labor agreements.
wages.quote: Fight for working people to have the ability to form a union and advocate for better working conditions.

housing.text: Wallace proposes a first-time homebuyer credit and a credit to spur construction of starter homes.
housing.quote: Establish a new first-time homebuyer credit and a starter home construction credit.

health.text: Wallace says she would reverse 2025 cuts to health care and rein in insurance companies by banning prior authorization and capping executive pay from premiums.
health.quote: Reverse the historic cuts to health care Congress voted for in 2025.
